title: strict-ts.json
description: The configuration of strict-ts, read beside tsconfig.json. Every key is optional.

$schema.description: The path or URL of this schema, for the editor.

unsafeDirs.description: The directories where unchecked code may live, relative to the project root: the equivalent of `unsafe` in Rust.

allowedImports.description: The packages safe code may import. Everything else is imported from an unsafe directory only.

pureDirs.description: The directories whose code must be pure, relative to the project root: no I/O, no clock, no randomness, no global state, no import of code that is not pure.

testDirs.description: The directories that hold tests, relative to the project root. A file named *.test.* or *.spec.*, or under a __tests__ directory, is a test wherever it is. A test may throw, call what throws and import what it needs.

assume.description: What the project says of itself and that no rule can check. "attached-buffers": no buffer is ever detached, so the methods of typed arrays and of DataView do not throw for that. "dom-as-observed": a function of the DOM that never threw when it was run in a browser is taken not to throw, although no specification was read for it.

rules.description: The rules to run. All of them when absent.

baseline.description: The path of the baseline file, relative to the project root.
